title: Genuine bank fraud call
blurb: HDFC's real fraud team blocks a card the right way: no OTP, no urgency, and an invitation to call back on the number on the card.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Meera calling from HDFC Bank's fraud monitoring team. Am I speaking with Mr. Rajesh Kumar? Before we go further: I will not ask you for your OTP, PIN, CVV or full card number on this call, and you're welcome to hang up and call the number on the back of your card instead.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, this is Rajesh. What's this about?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We flagged a transaction of ₹18,400 at a jewellery store in Jaipur at 2:10 PM today on your credit card ending 3320. Was that you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I'm in Pune. I haven't used that card today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Understood. I'm blocking the card right now as a precaution. You'll get an SMS confirming the block within a minute.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I got it. What about the ₹18,400?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The transaction was declined by our system, so nothing has debited. If you see anything else you don't recognise, you can dispute it from the app or by calling us.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you need any details from me?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No sir, nothing at all. A replacement card will be couriered to your registered address within 5 to 7 working days. You'll receive the delivery OTP from the courier company; that is only for the delivery agent at your door.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you'd saved the card on any website, update it when the new card arrives. And please never share any OTP with anyone who calls you. including anyone claiming to be from the bank.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks. Can I verify this call?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Absolutely. Your service request number is SR-77812. You can call the number on the back of your card or check the request in NetBanking under 'Service Requests'.
